queries: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS status_avg FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), kept AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg, b.overall_avg FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.status_avg > b.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, status_avg, status_avg - overall_avg AS above_baseline, ABS(status_avg - AVG(status_avg) OVER ()) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept
